_comment: The committed floor for the CLASSIFICATION suite. mvn verify fails below it.
Raise these IN THE SAME COMMIT as the prompt change that earned the gain, so the
pull request shows the improvement as a diff next to its cause. Lowering them is
allowed and is meant to be conspicuous: it is how you say 'we accepted a
regression', out loud, in front of a reviewer.
These figures are measured against the deterministic WireMock fixture, so they
describe the HARNESS, not a live model: with a stub that answers correctly the
suite scores 1.0, and the floor is set below that to leave room for the handful of
cases a real provider gets wrong. The number worth quoting from a live run belongs
in the README, dated, next to the model id it was measured on.
